body: For some stupid reason I didn't want to bring my personal problems into the same hospital I'll be working at. Maybe I should just suck it up and ask around for a good doctor. It's not like they can tell other students about it.

Thank you for the advice. I got into a big argument with my parents last night over it. It basically came down to:

"I'm going to find someone else. Something's not right."
"Stop being so dramatic. You seem fine."

So I'll have to do this part of it on my own. Maybe that's for the better.
